prov.heading: Provision for Credit Losses
prov.text: Our provision for credit losses at $9.2 million for the quarter increased $6.4 million from prior quarter and $5.3 million from prior year same quarter. Of the provision for the quarter, $8.6 million was attributable to the allowance for credit losses, with an additional expense of $0.6 million recognized in the provision for unfunded commitments. The increase in the provision was the result of the increase in net charge-offs during the quarter in addition to the significant loan growth we experienced during the first nine months of this year. Provision for credit losses for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 at $14.3 million was $4.7 million above same period prior year.

nonint.heading: Noninterest Expense
nonint.text: N oninterest expense for the quarter of $36.5 million was $0.9 million, or 2.4%, below prior quarter and $0.3 million, or 0.7%, below prior year same quarter. The quarter over quarter decrease primarily resulted from a $1.7 million decrease in the cost of our group medical and life insurance, included in employee benefits, partially offset by increases in salaries ($0.3 million), data processing expense ($0.2 million), and legal and professional fees ($0.2 million). The year over year decrease for the quarter primarily resulted from a $0.5 million decrease in data processing expense offset by a $0.2 million increase in legal fees. The decrease in the cost of group medical and life insurance year over year was offset by increases in salaries and bonuses. Noninterest expense for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 of $110.4 million was $3.8 million, or 3.5%, above prior year same period.

nonop.heading: Noninterest Expense
nonop.text: N oninterest expense for the quarter of $36.5 million was $0.9 million, or 2.4%, below prior quarter and $0.3 million, or 0.7%, below prior year same quarter. The quarter over quarter decrease primarily resulted from a $1.7 million decrease in the cost of our group medical and life insurance, included in employee benefits, partially offset by increases in salaries ($0.3 million), data processing expense ($0.2 million), and legal and professional fees ($0.2 million). The year over year decrease for the quarter primarily resulted from a $0.5 million decrease in data processing expense offset by a $0.2 million increase in legal fees. The decrease in the cost of group medical and life insurance year over year was offset by increases in salaries and bonuses. Noninterest expense for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 of $110.4 million was $3.8 million, or 3.5%, above prior year same period.

Net interest income.text: Net interest income for the quarter of $61.1 million was $0.2 million, or 0.3%, above prior quarter and $5.5 million, or 9.9%, above prior year same quarter, as our net interest margin, on a fully tax equivalent basis, decreased 17 basis points from prior quarter but increased 3 basis points from prior year same quarter. Our quarterly average earning assets increased $240.5 million, an annualized 3.7%, from prior quarter and $553.9 million, or 9.0%, from prior year same quarter. Our yield on average earning assets decreased 5 basis points from prior quarter and 10 basis points from prior year same quarter, while our cost of funds increased 14 basis points from prior quarter but decreased 23 basis points from prior year same quarter. Our ratio of average loans to deposits, including repurchase agreements, for the quarter was 86.2% compared to 87.2% for prior quarter and 85.6% for same quarter prior year. Net interest income for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 at $180.7 million was $19.9 million, or 12.3%, above same period prior year.

Noninterest income.heading: Noninterest Income
Noninterest income.text: Noninterest income for the quarter of $18.6 million was $1.0 million, or 6.0%, above prior quarter and $2.7 million, or 16.9%, above prior year same quarter. The variance quarter over quarter was primarily the result of a $0.9 million increase in deposit related fees. Increases in trust and wealth management income ($0.2 million) and brokerage revenue ($0.2 million) were offset by a $0.4 million decline in net securities gains, included in Other in the table above. Y ear over year increases for the quarter included net securities gains ($1.0 million), trust and wealth management income ($0.6 million), deposit related fees ($0.4 million), and loan related fees ($0.4 million). The variances in securities gains resulted primarily from changes in the valuation of our equity securities. Noninterest income for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 of $51.7 million was $4.6 million, or 9.9%, above prior year same period.

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
